name: clonevox
description: Generate studio-quality AI speech and voice synthesis using verified CloneVox voice profiles.

interface.shortDescription: AI speech in your own voice
interface.longDescription: CloneVox is a text-to-speech voice studio that speaks your scripts in your own identity-verified voice. Connect your CloneVox account to list your verified voices, check your usage, generate speech in 11 languages with an optional delivery style, and get play and download links for finished audio, all from chat. Creators use it for voiceovers, reels, YouTube videos and multilingual content. Only voices you have verified with CloneVox (plus CloneVox preset voices) can be used.
defaultPrompt: Generate 'Welcome to my channel' in my voice
